toril.name: Toril
toril.summary: Primary inhabited world of its local neighborhood.

selune.name: Selûne
selune.summary: Toril's moon. The alias field lets search and lore preserve alternate names without replacing the atlas label.

tears-of-selune.name: Tears of Selûne
tears-of-selune.summary: A cluster-scale region. Entering it is optional because major children such as Bral can also be direct scene links.

rock-of-bral.name: Rock of Bral
rock-of-bral.summary: A major destination that opens its own scene rather than a popup.

lucent-edict.name: Wreck of the Lucent Edict
lucent-edict.summary: A small feature that stays at popup scale.

aperusa-anchorage.name: Aperusa Anchorage
aperusa-anchorage.summary: A small anchorage that stays at popup scale until it merits a dedicated scene.
